```artifact
Feature: Login functionality for Doctor, Chemists, and Labs

  Scenario Outline: Successful login with default credentials
    Given the system has default credentials for Doctor, Chemists, and Labs
    When a user logs in with valid credentials
    Then they should access their respective dashboard

    Examples:
      | User Type | Credentials | Expected Dashboard |
      | Doctor    | Default     | Doctor Dashboard    |
      | Chemist   | Default     | Chemist Dashboard   |
      | Lab      | Default     | Lab Dashboard       |

  Scenario Outline: Unsuccessful login with incorrect credentials
    Given the system has default credentials for Doctor, Chemists, and Labs
    When a user logs in with invalid credentials
    Then they should receive an error message
    Examples:
      | User Type | Credentials | Expected Error Message |
      | Doctor    | Incorrect   | "Invalid Credentials" |
      | Chemist   | Incorrect   | "Invalid Credentials" |
      | Lab      | Incorrect   | "Invalid Credentials" |

  Scenario Outline: Login with expired credentials
    Given the system has default credentials for Doctor, Chemists, and Labs
    When a user logs in with expired credentials
    Then they should receive an error message
    Examples:
      | User Type | Credentials | Expected Error Message |
      | Doctor    | Expired     | "Credentials Expired" |
      | Chemist   | Expired     | "Credentials Expired" |
      | Lab      | Expired     | "Credentials Expired" |

  Scenario Outline: Login with locked account
    Given the system has default credentials for Doctor, Chemists, and Labs
    When a user logs in with a locked account
    Then they should receive an error message
    Examples:
      | User Type | Credentials | Expected Error Message |
      | Doctor    | Locked      | "Account Locked" |
      | Chemist   | Locked      | "Account Locked" |
      | Lab      | Locked      | "Account Locked" |

  Scenario Outline: Login with disabled account
    Given the system has default credentials for Doctor, Chemists, and Labs
    When a user logs in with a disabled account
    Then they should receive an error message
    Examples:
      | User Type | Credentials | Expected Error Message |
      | Doctor    | Disabled    | "Account Disabled" |
      | Chemist   | Disabled    | "Account Disabled" |
      | Lab      | Disabled    | "Account Disabled" |

```
